# ♿ Chat UI Accessibility Audit

## Audit metadata
- Commit:
- Auditor:
- Date:
- Browser:
- Assistive technology:

## Keyboard review
- [ ] Logical Tab order
- [ ] Visible focus
- [ ] Enter submits form
- [ ] Clear and minimize controls are keyboard operable
- [ ] No keyboard trap

## Screen-reader review
- [ ] Chat region has a useful name
- [ ] New messages are announced politely
- [ ] User and bot roles are identifiable
- [ ] Controls have accessible names and state
- [ ] Decorative icon is hidden from the accessibility tree

## Visual review
- [ ] Contrast measured
- [ ] Text zoom to 200%
- [ ] Reflow at narrow widths
- [ ] Focus not obscured
- [ ] Motion reduction honored

## Findings
Issue, WCAG criterion if applicable, severity, evidence, owner, and remediation.

## Limits
List untested browser/AT combinations. Do not claim conformance without a complete assessment.
